body: Chief on the HsmmResultCodec checkpoint: APPROVED — contextual decode(recall, view) only, no context-free Decoder; private[codec] DTOs; sparse maps as sorted explicit records with duplicate rejection before toMap; materialization through smart constructors → AlignWire factories → validated(candidateAnchors, Some(echo)) → mandatory matched; required top-level schemaVersion; HsmmCodecError distinct from AlignError. Two requirements: (1) pin the schemaVersion value ('hsmm/v1') in ADR 0001 next to the wire renderings and add a golden wire fixture (a real WOG inferred result encoded → committed JSON → decoded == original) so any DTO drift is caught; (2) the decoder must never partially construct: any AlignError from validated/matched maps to a typed HsmmCodecError.Rejected(alignError) with no HsmmResult value escaping. Build against m1's amended AlignWire signatures; candidate after m1's slice lands.
